Dashworks (dashworks.ai), a San Francisco AI workplace search assistant founded in 2020 by Prasad Kawthekar and Pratyaksh (Praty) Sharma; Y Combinator W20. Raised a $4M round led by Point72 Ventures (Jan 2022, TechCrunch), then a $5M seed extension from Point72 Ventures (July 2023, VentureBeat as republished by Top Tech News), bringing total capital raised to $9M. No Series A was found. HubSpot agreed to acquire Dashworks on April 16, 2025 (terms not disclosed), and the team joined HubSpot's AI product group (Breeze).

grants.name: Stanford GSB Center for Social Innovation Social Entrepreneurship Fellowship

funding_notes: Verified domain neuronav.org; Neurodiversity PBC d/b/a NeuroNav, Oakland, CA (2323 Broadway), a Stanford spin-off founded 2020 by Kimberly Schreiber (CEO) that provides independent facilitation and navigation for adults with intellectual/developmental disabilities in California's Self-Determination Program. Stanford GSB says it won a $110K Social Entrepreneurship Fellowship in spring 2020 (listed as a grant) plus a $25K government training contract (revenue, not counted). K. Ventures (Kennedy-family disability fund) made one of its first three investments in NeuroNav (company blog Nov 2024; ImpactAlpha Aug 2023), with no amount or round type given. Trackers (CB Insights/Caplight/Dealroom) list a ~2021 seed with Pear VC, Core Innovation Capital and Praxis, and about $4M total, but no primary announcement, amount or Form D was found, so it is not counted. Money was raised but the round type isn't public, hence unclear-round-type.

Verified domain onramp.us; OnRamp Technology Inc., a Boston-based B2B customer onboarding/engagement platform founded 2020 by Paul Holder (CEO) and Ross Lerner (COO). July 2024 PR: $14.2M raised across a seed (led by Contour Venture Partners) and a Series A (led by Javelin Venture Partners), with Pear VC, Quiet, Correlation, Frontier and J Ventures; no split between the two was given, so per-round amounts are null. Nov 2025: $15M completing the Series A, led by Koch Disruptive Technologies, with a company-stated total of $27M (amount_raised). The input's 'Series B' label is not supported; the latest public stage is Series A. Pear entered at Pre-Seed.
